docs: Feature showcase content: the heading, a description, one picture and an ordered list of two to six key points, each with a title and a line. One object is valid in every showcase layout (the picture at the end, at the start, above the points).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

image.docs: address of the picture; none: the placeholder

items.docs: the key points, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

description.docs: one line about the point; empty: none
